traits.name: Duergar Resilience
traits.desc: You have Advantage on saving throws against being Charmed or Paralyzed.

traits.name: Duergar Magic: Enlarge
traits.desc: Starting at level 3, you can cast Enlarge/Reduce (on yourself only) once per Long Rest.

traits.name: Duergar Magic: Invisibility
traits.desc: Starting at level 5, you can cast Invisibility (on yourself only) once per Long Rest.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks while in direct sunlight.
